omitted: Standard (paid) tier only. The page also lists Flex and Priority tiers; this schema models one rate per model per period, and Standard is the default tier.
Free-tier rates are not modeled: they are rate-limited quotas, not a price.
Context-length tiering (>200k prompts) on the Pro models and per-modality tiering (audio input) on the Flash-Lite and 2.5 Flash models are recorded in notes only - this schema has neither dimension.
The separate per-hour context-cache storage fee is not modeled: it is priced per hour, not per token.
Embedding, image, video and audio-generation models are excluded - priced in units this per-million-tokens schema does not model.
